name: When should I consider pressure washing my home's exterior surfaces?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider pressure washing my home's exterior surfaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressure washing your home's exterior surfaces is beneficial when dirt, grime, mold, mildew, or other environmental buildup becomes visible, usually on siding, decks, driveways, or patios. It's often recommended as a preparatory step before exterior painting or sealing. The frequency depends on your local environment and weather, but many homeowners find it beneficial annually or bi-annually to maintain appearance and prevent organic growth from damaging surfaces. Always ensure proper technique to avoid surface damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider pressure washing when dirt, mold, or grime build up on exterior surfaces, or before painting/sealing. Frequency depends on environment, often annually or bi-annually.
